s0.title: Open Health Connect
s0.desc: Tap the Health Connect row above to open or install it.

s1.title: App Permissions
s1.desc: Inside Health Connect, tap "App permissions" from the home screen.

s2.title: Find this app
s2.desc: Scroll to Rewards Planners and tap it.

s3.title: Enable Steps
s3.desc: Turn on "Steps" under the Read permissions toggle.

s4.title: Come back here
s4.desc: Return to this screen — the status refreshes automatically.

s5.title: Open phone Settings
s5.desc: Go to your phone's Settings app.

s7.title: Find Reward Planners
s7.desc: Search for and tap "Reward Planners" in the app list.

s8.title: Open Permissions
s8.desc: Tap "Permissions" on the app info screen.

s9.title: Allow the toggles
s9.desc: Turn on "Physical activity" and "Health Connect", then come back here.

s10.title: Connect Apple Health
s10.desc: Tap the Apple Health row above to show the iOS permission sheet.

s11.title: Allow Steps
s11.desc: In the Apple permission sheet, enable Steps and tap Allow.

s12.title: Come back here
s12.desc: Your step count refreshes automatically when you return.

s13.title: Open the Health app
s13.desc: Open Apple Health on your iPhone.

s14.title: Open Sharing
s14.desc: Tap Sharing, then Apps and Services.

s15.title: RewardsPlanners
s15.desc: Select RewardsPlanners and enable Steps access.
